declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this statement in support of preliminary approval. After the complaint survived a motion to dismiss, counsel negotiated a settlement that provides a $33 million class fund for approximately 400,000 identifiable members, with payments made automatically and no claim forms required. We initially proposed a $35 million class fund and $7 million in separately paid fees and expenses. Brightline countered with a $30 million fund and $6 million in fees and expenses. We then proposed the agreed $33 million fund and $6 million fee-and-expense amount, which Brightline accepted. From the outset, the proposed terms provided that fees would be subject to court approval, Brightline would make no clear-sailing commitment, and any fees not awarded would go to the class rather than revert to Brightline. The $33 million fund represents approximately 52% of the $64 million in disputed renewal charges. In my judgment, prompt automatic payments provide meaningful relief in light of the unresolved class-certification issue, the risk of losing at trial, and the two-to-three-year period before trial. The separately paid fee request remains for the Court to evaluate and approve.
